Golden Quadrilateral: Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai and back to Delhi, plus the North-South and East-West corridors. Class 10 Geography, on the map.

• Golden Quadrilateral: six-lane Super Highways linking the mega cities
• North-South corridor: Srinagar (J&K) to Kanniyakumari (Tamil Nadu)
• East-West corridor: Silchar (Assam) to Porbander (Gujarat)
• Implemented by NHAI, the National Highway Authority of India
